description.value: East Garden Chinese Restaurant is a neighbourhood Chinese restaurant on Belmont Avenue in Victoria serving a broad menu of Cantonese-influenced dishes including chow mein, fried rice, sweet and sour, and tofu specialties. The restaurant has an active online ordering system with pickup available, making it convenient for cyclists passing through the area. With 128 customer reviews it appears to be an established local dining option.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 94m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business is operational, with an active online ordering system for pickup. Address (2888 Belmont Ave, Victoria, BC V8R6T3) and phone (+1 778-406-1628) match OSM tags. The menu page explicitly lists numerous tofu and vegetable-only dishes confirming vegetarian options; pickup ordering is prominently featured. No website evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities. OSM name 'East Garden Restaurant' differs from the website name 'East Garden Chinese Restaurant'.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the name as 'East Garden Restaurant' but the website consistently uses 'East Garden Chinese Restaurant'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Chinese restaurant with an active website and online ordering system. A useful food stop for touring cyclists in Victoria.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian items including Vegetable Chow Mein, Mushroom Chow Mein, Vegetable Fried Rice, Sweet & Sour Tofu, Tofu with Black Bean Sauce, Ginger Fried Tofu, Salt & Pepper Tofu, Braised Tofu Hot Pot, Spicy Eggplant & Tofu, Broccoli with Garlic Sauce, and other all-vegetable dishes
